about_the_game:
A collection of game music composed by Masahiro Kajiwara.

Includes bonus tracks such as orchestral arrangements from the PS2 and i-mode versions.

21 songs from "RE: Sound Anchor Vol.2," produced to commemorate the release of the Nintendo Switch.

Contains additional songs from the PS2 version, songs arranged for i-mode, FM sound source versions by Masahiro Kajiwara, and orchestral arrangements by Masafumi Takikita.
